name: The Hunt Begins
summary: At Camp Narache, young hunters gather food and feathers for their people. Grull Hawkwind sends you to hunt plainstriders on Red Cloud Mesa, where the village relies on what its young can provide.

sections.title: A Tribe's Sustenance
sections.body: Tauren hunt on Red Cloud Mesa to feed and clothe their people. They value the stalk and chase as tests of discipline and as sport. When Camp Narache's stores run low, young hunters gather plainstrider meat for cooking and feathers for tribal garments.

sections.title: Earning Recognition
sections.body: Grull Hawkwind judges newcomers who hope to leave Red Cloud Mesa for Mulgore's wider plains. Before they can meet his father, Chief Hawkwind, he asks them to prove their ability. A successful hunt shows self-reliance and helps support the tribe.

faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind gives you this work in Camp Narache. Chief Hawkwind's son, he guides young hunters on Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Why are plainstriders hunted instead of other beasts?
faq.answer: Plainstriders are plentiful on the mesa. Their meat replenishes low food stores, and their feathers go into traditional tauren clothing and adornments.

faq.q: Why do I have to prove myself before seeing Chief Hawkwind?
faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind asks you to show basic survival skills and loyalty to the village before meeting Chief Hawkwind and taking on deeper responsibilities.

faq.q: What is the broader goal of these trials on Red Cloud Mesa?
aliases: why am i on red cloud mesa
faq.answer: Red Cloud Mesa tests young tauren before they descend to Mulgore's wider plains and enter Thunder Bluff, the capital city.

aliases: what is after the hunt begins
faq.answer: After you bring back meat and feathers, Grull approves your hunt and sends you to track larger game that is harder to find across the mesa.

faq.q: Do tauren only hunt for survival?
faq.answer: Tauren hunt for food and materials such as leather, bone, and feathers. They also hunt for sport and spiritual communion. Hunting sharpens the instincts that keep their tribes alert and strong.

angles.text: As a young shu'halo, your first hunt for plainstriders on the mesa binds you to the land and your duty to feed Camp Narache.
As a hunter, you practice marksmanship and tracking as you hunt the swift plainstriders of Red Cloud Mesa. You also learn to honor the beasts that sustain you.
